'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Joseph Graham DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet line 24 strikes a second [[We're In Attack Position Now]]; that copy is retained here so the published list remains 60 cards (59 without it).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joseph Graham]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
